title: tesouropy: access Brazilian National Treasury open-data APIs (Python)
description: tesouropy is a Python port of the R package tesouror. It provides a single, consistent interface to six open-data sources of the Brazilian National Treasury (Tesouro Nacional) and related federal government APIs — SICONFI (RREO, RGF, DCA, MSC and entity info), CUSTOS, SADIPEM, Constitutional Transfers, SIORG, and SIOPE (FNDE/MEC) — returning tidy polars DataFrames, with caching, retry, pagination, and fault-tolerant batch retrieval built in. The interface is bilingual (Portuguese/English).
